plumbing.name: Clean Trust
plumbing.description: Established and trustworthy: navy and blue, with your license and awards out front.
plumbing.brief:
Aesthetic: mountain blue heritage (Light-ground plumbing sites with blue brand accents, mountain imagery, photo-backed heroes and rounded or pill shapes, grounded by license, award and badge trust marks.)
Vocabulary: mountain photo backdrop, navy photo overlay, pill-shaped buttons, angled hero divider, translucent contact card, uppercase navy H2 headings, italic serif tagline, rounded white feature cards, accreditation and badge band, phone number in sticky nav, checkbox service-area list, dashed coupon card
Reference feel: Everest Plumbing, Greenville SC (everestplumbing.com), Master Service Plumbing, Reno (masterserviceplumbing.com)
House DNA: Phone number on the first mobile screen (9/12); Star-rated reviews on the homepage (7/12); Named list of towns served (7/12); Phone or call button pinned while scrolling (6/12); Trust strip of licenses, ratings and years near the top (6/12); Call is the primary conversion (6/12)
Never: Thin light-blue headings on white, Vague Read More as the only CTA, Faded grey text over busy photos, Muddy grey sections with weak hierarchy, Missing H1 and no lead form, Stray logos floating in white gaps, Phone number below the first mobile screen (3/12 real sites)
One risk: Make the mountain a brand device: a navy-overlaid summit photo behind the hero and reviews, with an angled cut edge and a mid-page call bar with a hand-drawn underline on the phone number.

WORKFLOW - asset first, page second:
Step 1. Generate the hero asset NOW, before any code. Fill [SUBJECT], then Higgsfield gpt_image_2, 16:9, resolution 2k, quality high:
  "16:9 full-bleed photo, 35mm lens at eye level, soft natural daylight, cool navy and teal palette with white highlights. [SUBJECT: plumber's gloved hands tightening copper pipe fittings in a clean utility space, with a faint mountain ridge in the far background]. Subject sits in the right third; the left two-thirds is a darker, smooth navy-toned area for a headline and a single button."
  It must read as a full-bleed hero background (camera inside the scene, edges bleed, negative space held for the headline) - not an isolated 3D asset or product render.
Step 2. Build the page AROUND the real asset - measure its negative space and place typography where the image leaves room.
Everything else: your call. Surprise me.
plumbing.heroTreatment: Full-bleed crew photo under a navy grade that is deepest behind the copy; an italic serif since-line, a white Montserrat headline, a white booking pill and an outlined call pill; a mountain-ridge edge cuts the photo off at the bottom. Mobile keeps the copy on the photo at a shorter height.
neverList: Thin light-blue headings on white
Vague Read More as the only CTA
Faded grey text over busy photos
Muddy grey sections with weak hierarchy
Missing H1 and no lead form
Stray logos floating in white gaps

Aesthetic: Dark Mode (OLED) (deep black, dark grey, high contrast, low white emission, visible focus)

Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Cheap visuals, Fast animations, Gray-on-gray text, Neon accents.

Copy left with a tall serif headline, a gold booking button and an outlined call button; the crew or trade photo right inside a hairline gold frame with a 0.25 black vignette at the lower edge only, no filter. neverList: Hidden contact info
No certifications
Cheap visuals
Fast animations
Gray-on-gray text
Neon accents

electrical.name: Premium Dark
electrical.description: Dark and gold on purpose: none of the 36 contractor sites we studied looks like this, so you will not look like anyone else in town.
electrical.brief:
Aesthetic: Dark Mode (OLED) (deep black, dark grey, high contrast, low white emission, visible focus)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion with a premium register. Hero > Proof > Solution overview > Clear CTA path.
Color strategy: Premium black + gold accent; gold reserved for the call to action and ratings.
Typography: Cormorant / Montserrat (Luxury Serif: elegant heading, geometric body).
Key effects: Minimal glow, dark-to-light transitions (200-300ms), hairline gold rules, no cheap visuals, no fast animations.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Cheap visuals, Fast animations, Gray-on-gray text, Neon accents.
electrical.heroTreatment: Dark page. Copy left with a tall serif headline, a gold booking button and an outlined call button; the crew or trade photo right inside a hairline gold frame with a 0.25 black vignette at the lower edge only, no filter. Mobile: framed photo band on top at a short height, copy below.
neverList: Hidden contact info
No certifications
Cheap visuals
Fast animations
Gray-on-gray text
Neon accents

electrical.name: Friendly Family
electrical.description: Family-owned and friendly: your crew up front, navy panels, amber buttons, and coupons right under the photo.
electrical.brief:
Aesthetic: safety amber builders (Light pages with dark charcoal or navy bands, safety yellow-amber buttons, condensed or tracked uppercase headings, full-bleed jobsite or landmark photo heroes.)
Vocabulary: full-bleed darkened photo hero, condensed uppercase headlines, safety yellow-amber CTA buttons, charcoal or navy utility bar, single accent color for all actions, photo tiles with translucent label bands, amber eyebrow label tags, numbered process steps, rounded photo cards, light gray CTA band, Google rating pill or review cards, check-circle bullet lists
Reference feel: Lea Electric, Boise (leaelectric.com), Jacob's Electric, Tucson (jacobselectricinc.com), Buddy & Sons Electrical Services, Tucson (buddyelectrical.com)
House DNA: Star-rated reviews on the homepage (8/12); Header that stays pinned while scrolling (6/12); Named list of towns served (6/12); Call is the primary conversion (6/12)
Never: Tiny headline over a busy photo, Lead form with no visible fields, Trust rests on one claim, no license number, Header without phone number or sticky bar, Four competing display fonts, Generic heavy icon grids for industries, Phone number below the first mobile screen (7/12 real sites)
One risk: Use a recognizable local landmark or real jobsite as the full-bleed hero, with a dark overlay, huge condensed caps headline and one amber button.

WORKFLOW - asset first, page second:
Step 1. Generate the hero asset NOW, before any code. Fill [SUBJECT], then Higgsfield gpt_image_2, 16:9, resolution 2k, quality high:
  "16:9 wide photo, eye-level DSLR, 35mm, of [SUBJECT: electrician working on conduit and panel in an unfinished building, or local downtown landmark at dusk]. Moody overcast or golden-hour light, charcoal and navy shadows with small warm safety-yellow accents, slightly desaturated with a dark gradient. Keep the left third and center-upper area calm and uncluttered for a large uppercase headline and button. No text, no logos."
  It must read as a full-bleed hero background (camera inside the scene, edges bleed, negative space held for the headline) - not an isolated 3D asset or product render.
Step 2. Build the page AROUND the real asset - measure its negative space and place typography where the image leaves room.
Everything else: your call. Surprise me.
electrical.heroTreatment: A navy panel with a Google rating pill, a condensed Oswald caps headline, an amber booking button and an outlined call button; the crew photo is cut on a diagonal against the panel, and coupon tickets overlap the bottom edge. Mobile: the diagonal photo band on top, the navy panel below.
neverList: Tiny headline over a busy photo
Lead form with no visible fields
Trust rests on one claim, no license number
Header without phone number or sticky bar
Four competing display fonts
Generic heavy icon grids for industries

electrical.name: Modern Minimal
electrical.description: Built for the job site: heavy type, navy bands and steel-blue buttons, and copy that talks spec and schedule.
electrical.brief:
Aesthetic: corporate navy commercial (Light off-white pages framed by navy header and footer bands, steel-blue accents and a full-bleed commercial photo hero, built for builders and developers.)
Vocabulary: navy header and footer bands, full-bleed commercial photo hero, steel-blue accent text, off-white content ground, geometric sans headlines, bold all-caps hero headline, flat rectangular buttons, red active nav tab, named client project proof, dual-office contact block, rounded-top content panel, dense but orderly paragraph copy
Reference feel: Hayes & Lunsford Electric, Greenville SC (hayesandlunsford.com), Parish Electric Company, Fort Worth (parishelectricftw.com)
House DNA: Star-rated reviews on the homepage (8/12); Header that stays pinned while scrolling (6/12); Named list of towns served (6/12); Call is the primary conversion (6/12)
Never: Thin low-contrast blue body text on off-white, White headline over busy photo without overlay, Cropped or overlapping glitchy hero collage, Long text-only walls with no visual breaks, Hero without a clear CTA button, Phone numbers without tel: links or sticky header, Phone number below the first mobile screen (7/12 real sites)
One risk: Make the hero a real project photo from a recognizable commercial job, with a navy overlay band carrying a bold headline and a prominent bid-request button.

WORKFLOW - asset first, page second:
Step 1. Generate the hero asset NOW, before any code. Fill [SUBJECT], then Higgsfield gpt_image_2, 16:9, resolution 2k, quality high:
  "16:9 wide hero photo, [SUBJECT: commercial or industrial site at dusk, such as a container port, retail building or warehouse with electrical work visible]. Shot from an elevated wide angle at blue hour with a 24mm lens, crisp detail, cool navy and steel-blue palette with small warm light accents. Leave the center and lower third calm and darker for a headline, with no text, logos or people in the foreground."
  It must read as a full-bleed hero background (camera inside the scene, edges bleed, negative space held for the headline) - not an isolated 3D asset or product render.
Step 2. Build the page AROUND the real asset - measure its negative space and place typography where the image leaves room.
Everything else: your call. Surprise me.
electrical.heroTreatment: Full-bleed crew photo under a navy grade from the left; a huge white League Spartan caps headline, a flat steel-blue bid button and an outlined call button; a navy rounded tab of stats is cut into the bottom-left corner. Mobile: the tab sits under the copy.
neverList: Thin low-contrast blue body text on off-white
White headline over busy photo without overlay
Cropped or overlapping glitchy hero collage
Long text-only walls with no visual breaks
Hero without a clear CTA button
Phone numbers without tel: links or sticky header
